description: This massive toad's jaw bones have grown out from its lips into a powerful beak, large enough to snap a bicycle in two.  The bony growths extend to its face, ringing its eyes and shielding its parotoid glands, swollen with poison.  Though intimidating, it appears more interested in a soothing mud bath than anything violent.

special_attacks.hit_dmg_u: %s catches you with its tongue and pulls you in!
special_attacks.hit_dmg_npc: %s catches <npcname> with its tongue and pulls them in!
special_attacks.miss_msg_u: %s's tongue lashes out at you, but you dodge!
special_attacks.miss_msg_npc: %s's tongue lashes out at <npcname>, but they dodge!

special_attacks.no_dmg_msg_npc: %s catches <npcname> with its tongue and pulls them in!
